title: Transfer item: a verb before “concerns”
instructions: Choose the option that expresses the intended meaning, forms a natural word partnership and fits the situation.

parts.prompt: The audit findings ___ serious concerns about how the records were stored.

choice_rationales.A: Rise does not take ‘concerns’ as a direct object; concerns themselves can rise, but findings raise them.
choice_rationales.B: Lift concerns normally means reduce or remove them, which reverses the intended meaning.
choice_rationales.C: Grow does not naturally take concerns as its direct object in this formal reporting frame.
choice_rationales.D: Raise concerns is the natural neutral-formal partnership for causing an issue to be considered.

parts.hint: The findings cause the concerns to be considered. Check which transitive verb naturally partners with ‘concerns’.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Raise serious concerns’ is the natural formal partnership and correctly makes the findings the cause.
